name: boss_stomp_oracle
description: ROM-audio-only Tricky 1 route. Both runners follow the proven one-player Tracks menu path, then retarget Ancient Lake's load to the Dino Domain boss race. The AI boss keeps moving without a hand-authored player line, so its stomps reach the ROM audio interface for comparison with the native mix. No state or frame score is claimed by this route.

ares_phase_offsets.basis: Inherited from the measured one-player Tracks menu route through the gameplay load; the boss retarget occurs only at that load.
